label: V6.2.7 CANDIDATE - FR entry then normal J1 hold
notes: Keep the first FR/RL placement and FR double angular adduction. The second step relaxes FR and brings the other J1 joints to normal adduction. Thereafter hold the normal J1 targets (about -8.99 CAD degrees), re-solving J2/J3 to preserve the final recovery X/Z goals. This is position-servo goal holding, not a physically welded joint. Stop still returns each diagonal to S. Offline experiment only.
